svg.title: HELIOS, solar energy intelligence
svg.desc: Plate IV. The title HELIOS, drawn as a cloud of points: the work exists but is not public. A schematic day of solar irradiance: a clear-sky curve, a dashed modelled forecast, a hatched band for the calibrated prediction interval, and observed points. Facts: physics plus machine learning, XGBoost with hold-out R-squared 0.856, calibrated prediction intervals.
